Energy check failed (macros imply about 171 kcal vs the stated 140); a reviewer accepted it: USDA's own label data is a confident, exact brand+description match (FROSTED GRAIN-FREE CEREAL, FROSTED, Magic Spoon Inc., GTIN 850002887457). The energy check fails (171 vs 140 kcal) only because the ingredients list a sweetener blend of allulose, monk fruit extract and stevia extract - allulose provides ~0.4 kcal/g rather than the ~4 kcal/g the energy check assumes for carbs, which accounts for the full 31 kcal gap. No Open Food Facts record to cross-check. This also corrects the catalogue's placeholder carbs (4g -> 14g), which was implausible for a cereal.
